The JSON Schemas in shared/contracts/, the Python enums in backend/app/db/models/enums.py, and any TypeScript union types in shared/types/index.ts must all match these lists — this file is the source of truth for what the values ARE; each language's file is the source of truth for how they're expressed in that language.
